        theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FiniteProjective.exists_star_iso {R : Type u} [Ring R] (Q : FiniteProjective Rᵐᵒᵖ) :
        ∃ (P : FiniteProjective R), Nonempty (↑P.star ≅ ↑Q)

        Every finite projective over the opposite ring is the dual of a finite ground projective. Evaluation realizes the isomorphism.
